Title: Recurring VPN disconnections for remote workers
RootCause: Under investigation - suspected MTU mismatch between GlobalProtect client and office firewall causing TCP fragmentation issues on certain ISPs. L2 Network team analyzing packet captures from 3 affected users.
Workaround: Users experiencing drops should switch to TCP mode in GlobalProtect settings (Settings > Connection > Protocol: TCP instead of Auto). Reduces throughput slightly but maintains stable connection.
PermanentFix: Planned: Update Palo Alto GlobalProtect gateway configuration to adjust MTU to 1400 and enable PMTUD. Change scheduled as CHG0002. Vendor TAC case 4410-8827 open for guidance on optimal settings.

Title: SAP GUI license management process gap
RootCause: SAP license renewal is tracked in a spreadsheet maintained by vendor management (Rajesh Bhat). No automated alerts configured. License expiry date was 2024-11-06 but renewal was missed because the tracking spreadsheet was not reviewed after October.
Workaround: No workaround for expired license - SAP access fully blocked until license key is applied.
PermanentFix: Implemented: New license key applied by SAP Basis team on 2024-11-08. Preventive: Created recurring calendar reminder (90/60/30 days before expiry) for Rajesh Bhat and Suresh Hegde. Added SAP license to IT asset management tool with automated expiry alerts.

Title: Intermittent slow internet affecting multiple floors
RootCause: Root cause was twofold: (1) ISP fiber splice degradation in building MDF causing bandwidth drops to 2 Mbps (INC0015) and (2) access points on auto-update firmware schedule rebooting during business hours and failing to rejoin controller cleanly (INC0009). Both issues masked each other during initial diagnosis.
Workaround: For ISP-side issues: Manual failover to backup 4G LTE link (limited to 50 Mbps shared). For AP issues: manually rejoin affected APs to wireless controller from controller dashboard.
PermanentFix: ISP replaced degraded fiber splice on 2024-11-12. AP firmware auto-update schedule moved to maintenance window (Sunday 02:00-04:00). Added monitoring alert in PRTG for WAN bandwidth dropping below 50 Mbps and for AP disconnect events.
